Company snapshot

Payments, loans and software for India’s small merchants – profitable since FY25, IPO papers filed in July 2026.

Founded in Mumbai in 2016. FY26 revenue was ₹2,184 Cr, up 35.5% on FY25, with a net profit of ₹148 Cr. The company filed its draft IPO papers (DRHP) with SEBI on 22 Jul 2026.

Growth

  • Revenue up 4.8x in 4 years
  • EBITDA margin −50% → +12%
  • ₹1,460 Cr cash vs ₹310 Cr debt

Recent events

  • DRHP filed with SEBI, Jul 2026
  • Rights issue at ₹172.5 in 2024
  • Consumer complaints up 12%

Before you buy

  • 6-month lock-in after listing
  • 12.5% LTCG only after 24 months
  • Selling before the IPO can be slow

Frequently asked questions

What is the Kestrel Payments unlisted share price today?

Stockify’s buy price is ₹412 per share (25 Sep 2026), up 17% in a year. The sell price is ₹398.

Is Kestrel Payments profitable?

Yes. It made a net profit of ₹148 Cr in FY26 on revenue of ₹2,184 Cr, after losses until FY24.

When is the Kestrel Payments IPO?

It filed its DRHP with SEBI on 22 Jul 2026. SEBI’s observation is awaited; no date or price band yet.

How do I buy Kestrel Payments unlisted shares?

Complete KYC on Stockify, choose at least 50 shares, pay from your bank account and get the shares in your demat.

Can I sell my shares right after the IPO?

No. Shares bought before the IPO are locked in for 6 months from the date of allotment in the IPO.

How are gains on unlisted shares taxed?

Held over 24 months: 12.5% long-term capital gains tax. Held 24 months or less: taxed at your income-tax slab.

Growth is slowing, still fast

Margins are the story

Billing help

What counts as a company page?

Opening one company counts as one page, however many tabs you read. Free pages reset at the start of each month.

Can I cancel Stockify Pro any time?

Yes, there is no lock-in. Cancel before your next billing date, monthly or yearly, and you won’t be charged again.
